text_read: digest; plus sed of source lines 7664-7731 (the continuation of the narrative)
mode_evidence: The first image, with eyes bandaged, is a reproduction of the cell and the master 'within me', a self-generated image told to him to 'reproduce his own image'. He then sees the master both with the physical eye and with spiritual sight and cries that either way 'it is you that I see'; the dazzling figure speaks 'in the voice of the heart' and is heard 'with my spiritual ear'; later figures pass 'before my inner sight'. The report treats the image as inner perception that becomes as vivid as ordinary sight, but not as an external light in the visual field.
onset_evidence: For someone seeing nothing: recite sura 112 a hundred thousand times; sit whole nights facing Mecca and concentrate on the heart while the master and adepts direct their attention (tawajjuh) at you. Three nights, nothing; on the fourth, toward dawn, 'some little light and clearness' in the heart, without colour or form. The master then bandages the eyes, tells the novice to reproduce his image and concentrate on the heart; the heart 'opens' immediately 'by the divine favor and by the spiritual assistance of the shaykh'. Transmission by the teacher is essential to the account.

conditions.posture: Sitting through the night with the face turned toward Mecca.
conditions.gaze_or_eye_position: Eyes bandaged by the master for the opening; later alternating bandaged and uncovered.
conditions.setting: In the master's cell, nights, with attention directed by the master and two adepts.
conditions.duration_and_schedule: Four nights before any light; then three months of figures; after a year, the doctrine of absolute reality.
conditions.prerequisites: A master who directs his attention; the novice's own recitation of sura 112 one hundred thousand times.

stages.label: light and clearness
stages.description: On the fourth night, a little light and clearness in the heart, with neither colour nor form.

stages.label: heart opens
stages.description: With eyes bandaged and the master's image reproduced, an overturned cup is set upright, with unbounded happiness; a faithful reproduction of the cell and the master within.

stages.label: dazzling figure
stages.description: A dazzling figure of 'Abd al-Qadir al-Jilani approaches and speaks to the heart.

stages.label: sphere of colours and images
stages.description: For three months, figures of the Prophet, Companions, angels and saints pass before the inner sight.

stages.label: sphere where all colour is effaced
stages.description: After three months the colourless sphere opens and all images vanish.

what_to_do_with_light: Remain seated, 'effacing thyself entirely in the marvels of that unknown world'; the colourless sphere replaces the images. Macdonald records that some teachers held lights to belong to the body and to be dangerous to attend to.
obstacles_and_fixes: Darkness of the heart: the shaykh says the gaze of the two adepts could not clarify it; the master himself had to act.
Other novices were prevented by other mystical exercises, the master says, from receiving the first apparition.
cautions: Macdonald reports that some Sufi teachers rejected the seven coloured-light scheme and thought it dangerous for the neophyte to pay too great attention to the lights, which belong to the body.
interpretation: The first apparition is the image of the master; the images belong to the sphere of colours and forms, which gives way to the sphere beyond colour.
practice_summary: Tawakkul Beg's account, in practitioner terms: Recite sura 112 a hundred thousand times. Sit through the night facing Mecca, attention on the heart, while the master and senior adepts direct their attention at you. If nothing opens for several nights, the master intervenes: sit before him, bandage the eyes, reproduce his image within, and concentrate everything on the heart. The heart opens, a replica of the room and the master appears within, and the image can be seen equally with the bandage on or off. A radiant figure then comes and speaks inwardly. Stay seated and efface yourself in the unfolding images; after about three months the images fall away into a colourless sphere. The key factor is the living master's directed attention.
